name: io.github.andreasjhagen/webcam
description: MCP server for capturing still images from an attached webcam

environmentVariables.name: WEBCAM_DEVICE
environmentVariables.description: Default webcam device to use. On Windows: the device name (e.g. "Integrated Camera"). On macOS: the AVFoundation index (e.g. "0"). On Linux: the device path (e.g. "/dev/video0"). Leave empty to auto-detect the first available camera.

environmentVariables.name: WEBCAM_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where captured images are saved. Defaults to a temporary directory.
